# Integrated NSW Feature Table — method report (S1-08)

*Generated by `pipeline.integration.merge` on 2026-09-03T05:09:16+00:00. Do not edit by hand.*


## 1. Method

The S1-02 analysis grid (`cell_id`, centroids, `area_km2`, geometry) is the
left side of five sequential **left joins on `cell_id`**, in this order:
wind (S1-03), geographic (S1-06), infrastructure (S1-05), demand (S1-04),
exclusions (S1-07). Each join is validated one-to-one and the row count is
asserted unchanged afterwards, so no cell is dropped or duplicated. Excluded
cells are **retained** with `eligible = False`.

Nothing is computed, reprojected or back-filled here: every input must already
be stored in EPSG:4326 (the loaders halt otherwise), and upstream
nulls stay null (the per-column null counts are checked to be identical after
the join). Distances and areas were computed upstream in EPSG:3577.

Columns dropped on purpose: `wind.units`, `wind.data_source` (constants: m/s, GWA v4), `demand.allocation_method` (constant: uniform), and S1-07's own `protected_area`, `protected_area_name`, `slope_deg`, `urban_area`, `wind_speed_100m_ms` (recomputed from rasters; compared in the WARN checks, never carried — the geographic and wind layers are canonical).

**Data confidence (S1-09).** After the join, `confidence.assess()` appends
`data_confidence`, `confidence_score` and `confidence_notes` from the ten scored
features' availability, their configured resolution and limitation factors, the
per-layer flags (`wind_confidence`, `demand_confidence`, `infra_confidence`,
`geo_confidence`) and S1-07's `data_flags`. Config `pipeline/integration/confidence_weights.yaml` (version
`1.0`, SHA-256 `3b34c47b8da6260b53245397491b0f60ed3df68d47434458ed93495295922f93`). Methodology:
`DATA/integration/metadata/confidence_method.md`; distribution report:
`DATA/integration/metadata/confidence_summary.md`.

| data_confidence | Cells |
|-----------------|-------|
| high | 1,600 |
| medium | 45,711 |
| low | 0 |

## 4. Column map

| Column | Source (layer.column) | Units / type |

| cell_id | grid.cell_id | str — grid identifier, byte-for-byte from S1-02 |

| centroid_lon | grid.centroid_lon | degrees (EPSG:4326) |
| area_km2 | grid.area_km2 | km² (computed in EPSG:3577 by the grid stage) |

| wind_confidence | wind.confidence_flag | flag: valid | no_data |

| source_region | demand.source_region | NEM region id, null outside every region |
| demand_confidence | demand.confidence_flag | flag: high | medium | low |
| dist_transmission_km | infrastructure.dist_transmission_km | km — EPSG:3577 centroid distance to nearest ≥132 kV line |
| dist_substation_km | infrastructure.dist_substation_km | km — EPSG:3577 centroid distance to nearest substation |
| dist_connection_km | infrastructure.dist_connection_km | km — EPSG:3577 centroid distance to nearest connection point |
| inside_rez | infrastructure.inside_rez | bool — cell intersects an EnergyCo REZ |
| rez_name | infrastructure.rez_name | str, null when not in a REZ ('; '-joined if several) |
| infra_confidence | infrastructure.confidence_flag | flag: high | low |
| elevation_m | geographic.elevation_m | m AMSL — mean of valid SRTM GL3 pixels |
| slope_deg | geographic.slope_deg | degrees — mean of valid Horn-slope pixels |
| tri | geographic.tri | m — Riley terrain ruggedness index (Glen-Innes sub-window only) |
| land_use | geographic.land_use | ALUM v8 tertiary class name of the modal NLUM code |
| protected_area | geographic.protected_area | bool — any CAPAD intersection (frozen decision Q6) |
| protected_area_name | geographic.protected_area_name | '; '-joined CAPAD names, '' when none |
| geo_confidence | geographic.confidence_flag | flag: high | low |
| eligible | exclusions.eligible | bool — no exclusion rule triggered (S1-07) |
| exclusion_reason | exclusions.exclusion_reason | text — ', '-joined reasons, null when eligible |
| triggered_rules | exclusions.triggered_rules | text — ', '-joined rule names, null when eligible |
| data_flags | exclusions.data_flags | text — '; '-joined non-exclusionary coverage flags |
| n_missing_features | derived — count of nulls over wind_speed, demand_proxy, dist_transmission_km, dist_substation_km, dist_connection_km, inside_rez, elevation_m, slope_deg, land_use, protected_area | int 0–10 — nulls among the ten scored feature columns |
| data_confidence | derived — S1-09 confidence.assess() over the ten scored columns, the four per-layer flags and data_flags (config confidence_weights.yaml) | flag: high | medium | low — composite data confidence (S1-09); thresholds in confidence_weights.yaml |
| confidence_score | derived — S1-09 confidence.assess() over the ten scored columns, the four per-layer flags and data_flags (config confidence_weights.yaml) | float 0–1 (3 dp) — weighted availability × resolution × limitation × upstream-flag factors; see metadata/confidence_method.md |
| confidence_notes | derived — S1-09 confidence.assess() over the ten scored columns, the four per-layer flags and data_flags (config confidence_weights.yaml) | text — '; '-joined reasons for reduced confidence, '—' when none |
